scope:
All 177 helper names / 368 contracts: actual type-signature witnesses.

This generator supplies real declared execution types and actual trivial source
metadata. It does not claim unresolved bridge/recipe/value-layout prerequisites
or emit a whole-metadata admission certificate. Each record states its scope.

provenance.size_justification: Complete ten-root objects preserve real framing, content identity and cross-namespace declarations for independent type/ABI/metadata/program tests. Each manifest explicitly distinguishes component predicates from complete factories; no runtime certificate is encoded. Deterministic generator/input SHA256 and per-object hashes make the generated corpus reproducible.
